news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax announced a positive pre-NDA meeting with the U.S. FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, with the agency aligning on the company's planned submission strategy, content and format. Abivax remains on track to submit its first NDA for obefazimod by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Reiterates Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its price target on Abivax to $180 while reiterating an Overweight rating, one of several sell-side upgrades (Piper Sandler to $175, Truist to $155) following the company's strong ABTECT maintenance data and positive FDA pre-NDA feedback. The moves lifted the Street's average target well above prior levels, with the consensus rating now Strong Buy across roughly a dozen covering analysts.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales/commercial operations, and market access as it builds out its U.S. commercial organization, including a Global Head of Marketing who previously worked on Amgen's TEZSPIRE and Takeda's ENTYVIO. The hires come ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA submission for obefazimod and signal preparation for a potential U.S. product launch.

news.headline: Abivax Shares Soar Amid Renewed Takeover Chatter
news.summary: Abivax shares surged roughly 26% after French outlet La Lettre reported the company had re-engaged investment bank Centerview amid renewed acquisition interest from large pharmaceutical companies. The report reignited long-running M&A speculation around the French biotech following its strong obefazimod Phase 3 data, though no formal bid was confirmed and Abivax has repeatedly declined to comment on or has denied earlier iterations of such rumors (including a March 2026 AstraZeneca report).

news.headline: Abivax $920 Million Cash Haul Lets It Prepare for Solo U.S. Launch Instead of Relying on a Buyer, CEO Tells CNBC
news.summary: Abivax's CEO told CNBC that the company's newly closed $920 million capital raise gives it the option to pursue an independent U.S. commercial launch of obefazimod rather than depend on being acquired by a larger pharma partner. The financing is expected to fund operations into 2029, including U.S. commercialization efforts for the ulcerative colitis drug.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed an upsized public offering of 7,360,000 American Depositary Shares for roughly $920 million in gross proceeds, after underwriters fully exercised their option to purchase additional ADSs. Net proceeds of about $874 million are earmarked to support the potential U.S. commercialization of obefazimod and extend the company's cash runway into 2029.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod, Demonstrating Meaningful Clinical Benefit in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Abivax reported positive interim ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 data showing continuous 50 mg obefazimod treatment produced 37.2% clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at week 44 among induction non-responders, while dose escalation recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed. The results, which also showed cancer rates in line with the broader patient population, addressed earlier safety concerns and strengthened the drug's long-term maintenance database ahead of a planned NDA submission in late Q4 2026, sending shares sharply higher.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA in July 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results release
catalysts.detail: Abivax's investor relations financial calendar lists half-year 2026 financial results for release on September 21, 2026, which should include an updated cash runway and NDA preparation timeline.

catalysts.label: Crohn's disease Phase 2b (ENHANCE-CD) induction data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease is anticipated, expanding the drug's potential beyond ulcerative colitis; company guidance on exact timing has varied between late 2026 and mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Potential takeover of Abivax by a larger pharmaceutical company
catalysts.detail: Abivax has reportedly re-engaged the investment bank Centerview amid renewed acquisition interest as of mid-July 2026, following earlier unconfirmed approaches involving Eli Lilly (January 2026) and a reported AstraZeneca exclusivity period that Abivax denied (March 2026); no formal offer has been confirmed by the company.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Abivax has built out a U.S. commercial leadership team ahead of a possible launch of obefazimod for ulcerative colitis, contingent on FDA acceptance and review of the planned NDA.

pulse: Abivax enters August 2026 riding strong momentum from positive Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance and long-term safety data for lead drug obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, a positive late-July pre-NDA meeting with the FDA, and a $920 million capital raise that funds operations into 2029 and a build-out of U.S. commercial leadership ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing. Sell-side analysts (Morgan Stanley, Piper Sandler, Truist) raised price targets sharply in late July to a Strong Buy consensus, while the stock remains highly volatile and subject to recurring, unconfirmed takeover speculation involving major pharmaceutical companies, most recently renewed Centerview-linked buyout chatter in mid-July, even as management emphasizes it can pursue an independent U.S. commercialization strategy. Near-term catalysts to watch are NDA submission progress, the September 21, 2026 H1 results release, the eventual Crohn's disease Phase 2b readout, and whether the ongoing M&A speculation resolves into a formal bid.
